title: GUN KILL TALLY
why: His yes to suggestion 29. Every gun now counts its kills. A round remembers which gun fired it, and when that round is the one that finishes a machine or a pillager, the kill goes on that gun. The count is kept in your save when a raid ends in an extraction or a death (an abandoned run counts nothing), and it shows as a KILLS line on the gun card when you pick a gun up, in the backpack, on the belt hover and on the stash hover. A swing of the crowbar, a grenade or a fire does not count for a gun. A rarity twin of a gun counts its own kills. An old save simply starts every gun at none.
now: Each gun counts its kills, and the tally shows on the gun card.
